author: Karl Rock
description:
This is a great example of how I found Sindhi people to be as I travelled around the province of Sindh, Pakistan. They were incredibly friendly, kind and hospitable, and I was constantly being welcomed into people’s homes, offered food and tea, and given blessings wherever I went.

The warmth and generosity of the people I met was one of the things that really stood out to me during my travels through Sindh.
title: What are Sindhi people like?
